title: Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics
qualification: Graduate in Arts, Commerce & Science or its equivalent from any recognised University.
age_limit: 5 years relaxation (upper age limit up to 35 years)

title: Assistant Sub-Inspector of Excise & Narcotics
qualification: Bachelor’s degree from a recognised University.
age_limit: 5 years relaxation (upper age limit up to 35 years)

title: Junior Scientific Officer (JSO)
qualification: M.Sc. (Cyber/Digital Forensics) OR M.Sc. Forensic Science (specialization in Digital/Cyber/Multimedia Forensics) OR B.Tech. or above in Cyber/Digital Forensics OR MCA/M.Sc. IT OR B.E. and above in Computer Science from a recognised University or Institute
salary: Selected candidates will be placed at Level - 7 in the Pay Matrix. The exact monthly pay range in rupees is not specified in the notification.
age_limit: A candidate must not be less than 18 years and not more than 30 years of age as on 1st August 2026. The upper age limit is relaxable by up to 5 years for ST/SC candidates, or as may be notified by the Government from time to time. Accepted proof of age documents are HSLC/HSSLC Certificates, Voters ID, or Digitised Birth Certificate.
application_fee: The exact application fee amount is not specified in the notification. It only states that if payment is made through UPI, it must be done using the mobile number registered for One-Time Registration (OTR), that persons with disabilities (PwD) are exempted from payment of the application fee, and that fees once paid are non-refundable under any circumstances.
selection_process: The notification states that a Direct Recruitment Examination for the post will be conducted by the Mizoram Public Service Commission, and that the syllabus for the examination is available for download on the Commission's official website. A detailed, stage-wise selection process (such as whether it involves a preliminary exam, main exam, and/or interview) is not specified in this notification. Candidates are advised to check the syllabus link and the Commission's website for further details.

title: Jr. Grade of Mizoram Legal Service (Legal Officer)
qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Law from a University recognized by Bar Council of India, Actively practicing as Advocate for not less than 3 years
age_limit: Minimum Age: 21 years || Maximum Age: 35 years || Upper age limit relaxable up to 5 years for ST/SC candidates.

title: Registrar
qualification: Master's degree with at least 55% Marks or its equivalent grade 'B' in the UGC 7 point scale from a recognized University/Institute.
salary: Level 14 as per 7th CPC (PB-4: 37,400 – 67,000 with GP 10,000/-)
age_limit: Maximum Age Limit: 56 years as on 10-08-2026.

title: Post Doctoral Fellow
qualification: First class in UG and PG, Ph.D Degree from an Institute of Repute, At least 2 research papers in SCI/ SCIE/ SSCI journals
salary: Rs. 65,000/month in the first year, increasing to 67,000/month
